title: Clock rate and acceleration from rest of a body with position-dependent factors

key_results.statement: Weak records, exact for every member, start and $\lambda$: body expectations differ from those of $e^{-iC_{\rm eff}\lambda}\phi$ by at most $2\kappa^2\sigma_X^2L^2\lambda^2\lVert O\rVert$.
Velocity operator of the class: $\mathrm d\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda=\langle\hat v\rangle$ with $\hat v=-\frac{\tau}{2}\sum_x\zeta_x(R_x+R_x^\dagger)\otimes\sigma_1$, exact for every $\kappa$.

Acceleration operator: $\hat a=\frac{\tau^2}{2}\sum_x(\zeta_x^2-\zeta_{x-1}^2)P_x+\frac{\tau}{2}\sum_x\zeta_x[(R_x+R_x^\dagger)\sigma_2(\mathsf M_x+\mathsf M_{x+1})+(V_{x+1}-V_x)(-iR_x+iR_x^\dagger)\sigma_1]$.

Exact second derivative for every $\kappa$: $\mathrm d^2\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda^2=\langle\hat a\otimes 1+\kappa A_\zeta\otimes(X-\langle X\rangle)\rangle$; the second term is $0$ at $\lambda=0$ and $O(\kappa^2)$ later.
For $S_k$ and $S'_k$, exactly: $\mathrm d\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda(0)=0$ and $\mathrm d^2\bar x_{\rm lab}/\mathrm d\lambda^2(0)=\frac{\tau^2}{2}\sum_x(\zeta_x^2-\zeta_{x-1}^2)\phi_X(x)^2$.

First-order acceleration on the infinite chain: $a^{(1)}(\lambda)=\int\frac{\mathrm dp}{2\pi}\lvert\tilde\phi_X\rvert^2\alpha(p,\lambda)$ with $\alpha$ smooth, even in $p$ and independent of $x_0$; the zeroth order vanishes.
Wide-start limit: $a^{(1)}_\infty(\lambda)=\tau^2g_\zeta\cos(2M_k\lambda)+\frac{2\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F-G_k)\sin^2(M_k\lambda)-2\tau^2G_k\lambda\sin(2M_k\lambda)$, $G_k=mg_m+d_kg_\eta$.

Finite width: $\lvert a^{(1)}-a^{(1)}_\infty\rvert\le\frac{\pi^2}{8}\delta_W^2\sup_p\lvert\partial_p^2\alpha\rvert$ with $\sup_p\lvert\partial_p^2\alpha\rvert\le c\,\tau b_1(1+M_k\lambda)(1+\tau\lambda)^3$ and $\delta_W^2=O(W^{-2})$.
First-order velocity: $v^{(1)}_\infty=\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F-G_k)\lambda+\frac{\tau^2G_k}{M_k}\lambda\cos(2M_k\lambda)+\frac{\tau^2}{2M_k^2}(M_kg_\zeta-\mathcal F)\sin(2M_k\lambda)$.

Window average $\overline{a^{(1)}_\infty}=\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}[(\mathcal F-G_k)+G_k\varsigma+(M_kg_\zeta-\mathcal F)\rho]$; $\varsigma=\cos(2M_kT)+O(\lambda_1/\Lambda)$ does not decay, so the coefficients of $g_m$, $g_\eta$ have no long-window limit.

Secular acceleration $a_{\rm sec}:=\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F-G_k)$, the long-window limit of $2[\bar x^{(1)}_{\rm lab}(\Lambda)-\bar x_{\rm lab}(0)]/\Lambda^2$ with relative error $O(1/(M_k\Lambda))$.
Second-order remainder on a chain reaching $\ell$ sites from $x_0$ with $b_1\ell\le M_k$: at most $c\,\tau M_k[b_1\ell(\lambda+M_k^{-1})]^2$ for all $\lambda\ge0$; a sufficient range only.

Well-defined form: $a_{\rm sec}=-\frac{8t^2}{\Delta_k}\delta E^+_k$, with the gap $\Delta_k$, the hopping norm $t$ and the neighbour difference $\delta E^+_k$ of the upper on-site eigenvalue of the effective body contract.
Other branch $S'_k$: $a'_{\rm sec}=-\frac{\tau^2}{M_k}(\mathcal F+G_k)=+\frac{8t^2}{\Delta_k}\delta E^-_k$.
Variants, $a_{\rm sec}$ for $S_k$: (a) $-g\tau^2$; (b1) $-g\tau^2m/(m+d_k)$; (b2) $-g\tau^2d_k/(m+d_k)$; (c) $-g\tau^2$; (d) $\tau^2\mathcal F/(m+d_k)$.

Uniform profiles: $q(a;\lambda)=P_N(a;\Gamma_\ast(p_0)\eta_\ast\lambda/\lambda_0)+\mathcal R_\ast$ with $\Gamma_\ast=\bar\mu_\ast/\sqrt{\bar\mu_\ast^2+\tau^2\zeta_\ast^2\sin^2p_0}$, $\bar\mu_\ast=m_\ast+\eta_\ast\bar d$.
Tick for uniform profiles: $\lambda_\ast(p_0)=\lambda_0/(\eta_\ast\Gamma_\ast(p_0))$ and $\lambda_\ast(0)=\lambda_0/\eta_\ast$, independent of $m_\ast$, $\zeta_\ast$, $V_\ast$.

Linear profiles, start $S_{\rm clock}(x_0)$: $q(a;\lambda)=P_N(a;\eta_{x_0}\lambda/\lambda_0)+\mathcal R_{\rm cl}$; $q$ is even in the gradients for even $w$, and the width first enters at order $(g_\eta s_W\lambda/\lambda_0)^2$.
Rate at $x_0$: $\mathrm d\vartheta_{x_0}/\mathrm d\lambda=\eta_{x_0}/\lambda_0=\frac{N}{2\pi}(E^+_{x_0,k+1}-E^+_{x_0,k})$; tick $\lambda_0/\eta_{x_0}$.
Ratio of rates at two places, compared at equal $\lambda$ (A8): $\eta_{x_1}/\eta_{x_2}=(1+g_\eta x_1)/(1+g_\eta x_2)$; $(1+gx_1)/(1+gx_2)$ in (a), (b2), (c) and $1$ in (b1), (d).
Among the five variants only (a) and (c) have both a secular acceleration from rest independent of $k$ and $m$ ($-g\tau^2$) and a place-dependent clock rate.

definitions.name: effective body contract with fluctuation term of the records
on-site eigenvalues, gap, hopping norm and neighbour differences
level gradient of the rest and clock term
window factor of the growing oscillation

open_issues: At strict first order the plain window average of the acceleration has no long-window limit when G_k ≠ 0 (proven); the fate of the growing oscillation beyond first order, in particular when |G_k| W λ is not small, is not derived here.
The range (3.16) of the first-order treatment is a sufficient condition; the sharp range is not determined.
The second-order coefficient of the beginning motion in the clock distribution is given only for variant (d).
For unbounded bond profiles the limit of a long chain is not shown.
The rates at two places are compared across two runs through A8; a comparison inside one description is not treated.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions (unit 1/λ² for accelerations, 1/λ for rates) and the case of zero gradients: Model D operators of (6.12), vanishing first-order acceleration, P_N(a; λ/λ0), ratio 1.
Variant (d) against (6.12), (6.13), (6.24), (6.15), (6.20): operators, 2τ²F sin²(M_k λ)/M_k, and average τ²F(1−ρ)/M_k agree.

τ → 0: accelerations vanish and the clock formula becomes the exact mixture over places; an independent order-τ² expansion in the interaction picture of the on-site term reproduces the three terms of (3.13).
